purpose: Prospective same-information 64-state native PhysX falsifier. Match exact initial PPO reset, true t2,t3 applied/held, full physical command prefix, t4 known-delivered neutral step and both public achieved XYZ samples for source full-history selector, original 0.95 Gaussian-residual-weight baseline and t5 private reader. Never claim a heuristic's normalized weights are calibrated Bayesian posterior probabilities.
prior_exposure: Existing 16-state two-task Bayes-style source cohort 1700001..1700008 / 1710001..1710008 is a DEVELOPMENT/PILOT cohort; the new64 distinct seeds 1760001..1760032 / 1770001..1770032 were chosen BEFORE inspecting the 16-state outcomes in this new registration. The 16-state run may complete independently and cannot be pooled as 80 independent prospective trials.
fault_truth_schedule: two unknown ACKs at t2,t3; each of four actual applied/held joint truths 8 per task, seed truth index=(seed-1)%4; physical command and all achieved and commanded state must match across full-history, 0.95-residual-weight and fixed-read arms at t4 before t5 decision

original_algorithms_frozen.A: same previous complete-history compatible residual set unique admission; fallback one countable read
original_algorithms_frozen.B: same previous finite normalized residual weights exp(-0.5 (r/epsilon)^2), confidence threshold 0.95, winning residual <=epsilon, else same read; HEURISTIC score, not a calibrated probability; never retune 0.95 or epsilon on these cases
original_algorithms_frozen.C: same exact native physically aligned t2/t3 prefix then t4 identical known-delivered neutral, mandatory one state read at t5
original_algorithms_frozen.information: A and B each receive exactly same two public achieved-XYZ samples, same native t4 physically stepped neutral observation, no other probing actions. C fixed read gets no source public history selection, but still physically experiences identical prefix and neutral. Account A,B public samples and all hidden state getter counts separately.

primary_outcomes: Paired actual official task successes on exact same source reset
Original private controller target read costs for A,B,C
One full native 6D history true/false confident labels for A,B under actual physics audit-only target
Before-t5 physical prefix identity including both target/achieved position and orientation
All four joint physical truth strata x two original frozen PPO tasks, 8 each
Full source runner output, untouched per-episode negative cases, exact source SHA256 evidence
preregistered_failure_policy: If 0.95 heuristic outperforms, underperforms or falsely authorizes, publish exact result. Do not change posterior parameters or remove failures. If physical prefix diverges, abort as experiment invalid instead of claiming a method effect. The original 16-state results are development evidence and excluded.
interpretation_limits: Same-public observation does not equate to ActionShift DualABI official baseline, robot task success ≠ latent identification correctness, no hardware/network ACK packets, only Panda native target-relative controller, two released PPO policies, owner-operated PhysX not independent external validation. 64 paired trials do not establish statistical noninferiority without a pre-specified margin and CI.
